# Golden vectors for the HMAC projections the module and the server both
# sign (CLAUDE.md hazard #5). Read by the firmware unit test
# (access_module/test/unit/test_access_protocol.cpp) and the Go tests in
# server/internal/grpcapi and server/internal/devicesig: a change on one
# side that the other does not make fails a test.
#
# The key is a test value, not a deployment secret.
#
# Format: whitespace-separated fields, one vector per line; "-" stands for
# an empty field. The last two fields are always the projection and its
# lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 under the key.
#
#   heartbeat   module_id sequence
#   access      module_id credential_id nonce_hex requested_at
#   provision   module_id uid_hex
#   access_resp module_id credential_id nonce_hex granted(0|1)
